event: US declares 'Guardian of Hormuz', reinstates blockade + 20% cargo toll
reasoning: Tolling a global chokepoint + Hormuz blockade = direct crude/freight spike; Indian crew killed. Strong negative India-import channel.

event: Trump orders Operation Epic Fury (war initiation order)
reasoning: War-onset shock; broad risk-off. Oil channel opens but no infrastructure hit yet.

event: Natanz nuclear facility damaged (IAEA-confirmed); ground op inside Iran
reasoning: Max geopolitical severity but limited direct energy transmission; NIFTY impact via risk sentiment more than oil supply.

event: Iran declares indefinite closure of Strait of Hormuz
reasoning: The single strongest oil+gas+freight shock available; India's primary import route. Largest expected NIFTY drawdown driver.

event: US bombs Kharg Island, Iran's main oil-export hub
reasoning: Removes major crude volume from market; strong oil channel, direct energy-target.

event: US declares naval blockade of Strait of Hormuz
reasoning: Blockade of India's key oil artery; crude + insurance channels both fire.

event: US and Iran agree to stop attacks (ceasefire ending main war phase)
reasoning: De-escalation: expected relief rally / oil easing. Rare positive-direction event for NIFTY.

event: Islamabad Memorandum in force; first US-Iran talks (Pakistan/Qatar mediated)
reasoning: Diplomatic progress; mild positive. Pakistan/Qatar brokerage, regional not Western.

event: QatarEnergy declares force majeure, shuts LNG liquefaction
reasoning: Largest LNG-supply cut; strong gas channel relevant to Indian gas importers.

event: Iran strikes Qatari LNG tanker (Nakilat); US revokes Iran oil deal
reasoning: LNG carrier targeted + oil-deal collapse; gas and crude channels both active.

event: Iranian missiles hit Qatar's Ras Laffan (world's largest LNG complex)
reasoning: Direct hit on the largest global LNG node; gas-supply shock.

event: Israel hits Iran's oil facilities for the first time
reasoning: Opens energy-infrastructure phase; crude channel.

event: CENTCOM begins airstrikes on Iran
reasoning: Kinetic war onset; broad risk-off + oil.

event: South Pars gas field hit; Caspian strikes on Russia-Iran arms route
reasoning: World's largest gas field struck; gas channel + Russia dimension.

event: Shipping insurance rates for the strait up 4-6x in a week
reasoning: Direct freight-cost transmission to Indian import bills; purest insurance-channel signal.

event: Kuwait Petroleum declares force majeure, cuts oil output
reasoning: First sovereign crude-supply withdrawal; strong oil channel.

event: UNHCR: 3 million internally displaced in Iran
reasoning: High geopolitical/humanitarian weight but near-zero direct market channel; NIFTY-neutral.

event: Trump threatens power plants/bridges; eyes Kharg seizure; 7 vessels hit/week
reasoning: Escalation + sustained shipping attacks incl. crew casualties; oil + freight channels.

event: IMO extraordinary session; ~20,000 seafarers stranded on 3,200 vessels
reasoning: Trade-flow paralysis; freight channel + Indian seafarers heavily represented in Gulf crews.

event: New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vows to keep Hormuz closed
reasoning: Signals prolonged closure; sustained oil/gas risk premium.

event: US sinks 17-19 Iranian ships incl. a submarine
reasoning: Naval milestone; modest market channel via escalation.

event: US strikes 80+ Iranian targets; Iran hits 85 US targets across Gulf
reasoning: Largest single-day exchange; broad Gulf spillover raises risk premium.

event: E3 back military measures; UK approves US use of British bases
reasoning: Internationalization; mild negative via widening-conflict signal.

event: Islamabad talks collapse (Vance/Kushner/Witkoff; Iran rejects terms)
reasoning: Failed diplomacy triggered the blockade; negative via lost off-ramp.

event: Iran hits Emirates Global Aluminium (year-long damage)
reasoning: Non-oil industrial supply-chain hit (global aluminium); minor market channel.

event: Qatar joins Pakistan as co-mediator of the war
reasoning: De-escalation signal; mild positive.

event: US deploys scatterable antitank landmines in Iran (first since 1991)
reasoning: Norms/IHL weight; negligible market channel; NIFTY-neutral.

event: Hormuz traffic collapses to 5 ships/day (from 26)
reasoning: Measured ~80% transit collapse; concrete supply-tightening signal on India's route.

event: Iran ends all peace talks with the US
reasoning: Diplomatic rupture before final escalation; negative.

event: China's FM tells Iran reopening Hormuz is 'unanimous interest'
reasoning: Great-power pressure toward reopening; mild positive/relief signal.
